parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: forwarding-class
parameters.explanation: 转发类名称，用于区分不同的流量类别。

set class-of-service rewrite-rules exp M.template: set class-of-service rewrite-rules exp [parameter1] forwarding-class [parameter2] exp [parameter3]
set class-of-service rewrite-rules exp M.command: set class-of-service rewrite-rules exp MPLS-EXP-OUTBOUND forwarding-class AF4 exp 5

set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from dscp [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.command: set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INBOUND term AF4 from dscp af41
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的匹配条件。

set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then dscp [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.command: set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INBOUND term AF4 then dscp 18
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，修改DSCP值。

set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then forwarding-class [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.command: set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INBOUND term AF4 then forwarding-class AF4
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，设置转发类。

set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.command: set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INBOUND term AF4 then accept
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，接受匹配的流量。

set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.command: set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INBOUND term default then accept
set firewall family inet filter DSCP-INB.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的默认动作，接受未匹配的流量。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 2.2.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
